desc: Orlivane dog boots come as a set of 4 for small dogs. Each boot has a water-resistant fabric upper, an elastic cuff, a double hook-and-loop strap and a textured non-slip sole. Choose the size by paw width: S 1.97 in, M 2.36 in, L 2.76 in, XL 3.15 in. Colors: black and red.
b: SET OF 4 BOOTS — One pack includes 4 boots, one for each paw, in black or red.
STAYS IN PLACE — An elastic cuff at the top and a double hook-and-loop strap on each boot help hold the boot on the paw during walks.
TEXTURED NON-SLIP SOLE — The textured sole gives grip on smooth floors and wet pavement.
KEEP PAWS CLEAN — The water-resistant fabric upper helps keep mud and rain off the paws, so less dirt comes back into the house after a walk.

4 SIZES — S boot height 5.12 in / paw width 1.97 in; M 5.91 / 2.36 in; L 6.69 / 2.76 in; XL 7.28 / 3.15 in. Measure the width of your dog's paw before ordering (manual measurement, allow slight deviation).
